long_biography.plain_text:
Gomes was already operating Stevens 112 Ford when he formed dealership and property companies for Ford Lincoln of Smithtown in 2007. He held an 80 percent interest in both ventures and continued running his earlier Ford store. The Smithtown business added a second substantial operating platform alongside the Patchogue dealership.

In 2021, Gomes acquired Riverhead Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram while also owning Ford and Lincoln dealerships in Smithtown and Jersey City. The acquisition broadened his franchise mix and Long Island footprint. Riverhead remains his principal operating affiliation, while a recent property purchase for an auto-parts warehouse shows continuing investment in infrastructure supporting the dealership group.

uncertainties.detail: Steven Gomes is a common name with unrelated finance, audio-industry, academic and small-business profiles. Gomes dealership record, exact Long Island geography and independently reported portfolio form a direct identity bridge, so namesake facts are not transferred.

The New York court record uses Steven S Gomes for the exact Ford Lincoln of Smithtown controlling member and pre-existing Ford-dealership owner. S. is proposed without expansion because the full middle name appears only in people-search data that does not meet the dossier's evidence standard.

The source record stores 6 August 1965, and commercial people-search pages associate that date with a same-name Brookhaven resident. No strong primary, institutional or independent biographical source reviewed confirms the date or supplies a birthplace or birth country. The existing date is preserved without a correction, while the missing birthplace fields remain unfilled.

Official records establish that Gomes owned a Ford dealership before the 2007 Smithtown venture and later expanded through acquisition. They do not establish how the first store was financed or acquired, whether family resources were involved, or whether he had another material starting advantage. Wealth Origin therefore remains Unknown.

Gomes was the controlling member of newly formed Smithtown companies and later acquired Riverhead, but the reviewed evidence does not establish that he founded the earlier Stevens 112 operating platform. Operator captures documented ownership, control and active dealership leadership without overstating the original formation history.

The 2021 acquisition report names dealerships in Patchogue, Smithtown, Jersey City and Riverhead. Current evidence confirms the Riverhead affiliation and describes Gomes as an owner of Long Island dealerships, but it does not publish a consolidated ownership chart for every store. The biographies use the documented acquisition-era portfolio and avoid claiming that every legal interest remains unchanged.

The 2026 industrial-property purchase is tied to a planned auto-parts warehouse, and Riverhead's assessment roll links Gomes to dealer property. These assets support the automotive operation rather than proving that Real Estate is a separate principal wealth sector, so Automotive remains both industry classifications and no real-estate tag is proposed.

The existing LinkedIn is exact and identity-resolving. No identity-verified personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia page or personal website was found. Dealership websites are business properties rather than personal profiles, so no new social is proposed.

Automotive dealerships is the sole minimum-useful approved active tag because franchised dealership ownership and operation define Gomes's wealth platform and continuing mandate. Automotive distribution is excluded because retail franchises do not establish wholesale distribution, and broader retail or real-estate tags would add less precise retrieval value.
